full_prompt_en: A square Japanese woodblock-style still life shows a white cat sleeping beside painted ceramic vessels and large peony blossoms against an aged cream ground. The warm paperlike background occupies the upper half, marked by faint vertical joins, scattered wear and a small cluster of fine dark calligraphic strokes near the center-right. The writing is too small to read reliably. At the upper left, an open pale flower rises above a fuller coral-red blossom, both held by dark blue-green leaves with sharply cut veins and edges. Across the lower left, a folded fan or paper form lies on the dark tabletop, partly tucked beneath the wide red flower. Near the center stand two rounded blue-green vessels. Their surfaces carry dark floral ornament and warm rust-colored details, and a small shallow bowl sits in front of them. The white cat occupies the lower right, curled close to the pots with its head resting on its forepaws and its eyes closed. Fine brown outline strokes define the ears, paws and relaxed face, while spare gray shading gives the pale body its volume without losing the clean printlike areas. The tabletop is a broad deep brown band that grounds the closely arranged forms. Light is calm and even, leaving only soft shading beneath the animal and objects rather than sharp cast shadows. The overall composition balances densely patterned flowers and ceramics against the quiet white curve of the sleeping cat, with worn paper warmth unifying the scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、日式木版画风格的静物里，一只白猫睡在彩绘陶瓷器皿与大朵牡丹花旁，背景为旧奶油色。温暖的纸质背景占据上半部，带有淡淡竖向拼接线、散在的磨损和靠近中心偏右的一小簇细黑书法笔画。字迹太小，无法可靠辨读。左上方一朵浅色开放的花高于一朵更饱满的珊瑚红花，两者被带有清楚叶脉和切割状边缘的深蓝绿叶片托住。左下方，一把折扇或纸制形体躺在深色桌面上，部分塞在宽大的红花之下。中央附近立着两只圆鼓的蓝绿色器皿，表面有深色花卉纹样和暖锈色细节，一只小浅碗放在前方。白猫位于右下，紧挨罐子蜷伏，头枕在前爪上，双眼闭合。细棕色轮廓笔触勾出耳朵、爪子和放松的脸，简省灰色阴影赋予浅色身体体积，又保留干净的版画色块。桌面是一条宽阔的深棕色带，稳稳托住紧密排列的形体。光线平静均匀，动物和器物下方只有柔和暗部，没有尖锐投影。整体构图使纹样繁密的花与陶器同安静的白猫曲线相平衡，磨旧纸色的暖意统一了场景。
style_prompt_en: The printlike image joins fine brown-black outlines with flat but subtly varied areas of mineral blue-green, coral, cream and rust. Contours remain clean around major shapes, while thin internal lines describe veining and ornament without heavy tonal modeling. Aged paper grain, faint seams and small scattered marks soften the otherwise precise design. Color is concentrated in a few richly patterned clusters against a spacious warm neutral field. Light is even and gentle; shallow gray-brown shading gives volume where forms meet but avoids deep dramatic shadow. The compact lower arrangement and quieter upper space create a poised rhythm between decoration and rest, with muted surface wear supplying an antique character.
style_prompt_zh: 这类近似版画的图像把纤细棕黑轮廓同矿物蓝绿、珊瑚红、奶油色与锈色的平涂色域结合起来，色域内部仍有细微变化。主要形体周围的边线保持清楚，内部则以细线描写脉络和纹样，而不依赖厚重明暗塑形。旧纸颗粒、淡淡接缝和零散小痕迹，缓和了精确的设计。颜色集中在少数纹样丰富的区域，与宽敞暖中性色域相对。光线均匀温和；形体接触处的浅灰褐阴影带来体积，却没有深重戏剧性暗影。下方紧凑的排列和较安静的上部空间，在装饰与休憩之间形成从容节奏，压低的表面磨损感则赋予古旧气息。
theme_en: A sleeping white cat beside peonies and painted ceramic vessels
theme_zh: 白猫睡在牡丹花与彩绘陶瓷器皿旁
name: Keisai Eisen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
